notes: *where* is given to `šām`, whose locative sense the word carries (rule 11), and the waw is left `unrepresented`; the competing reading gives the relative connective to the waw under rule 17.
`məlēʾāh` keeps the *of* of *full of*, the only way English writes that predicate (rule 33's closing paragraph).
Margin *Or, for foraging* read and set aside; the printed *into* on `lə` governs (rule 38).
